title: Casio Men 3H Watch MTP-E515D-1AVDF
description: A cool metal analog timepiece with the sporty chronograph design you love and the detailed display you need. Three inset dials display 24-hour time, second stopwatch, and minute stopwatch. Water resistance up to 50 meters frees you from worry, even on rainy days.
features: 1-second stopwatch Measuring capacity: 59’59 Measuring modes: Elapsed time, split time, 1st-2nd place times
Regular timekeeping: Analog: 3 hands (hour, minute, second), 3 dials (24-hour, stopwatch minutes, stopwatch seconds)
